decisions.summary: R4 recommendation 1 (go) waits for this round's figures; recommendations 2-4 built first, then one equivalent page, then the rest
decisions.why: The GM's words: implement two, three and four, then another round of equivalent work 'before we proceed with all remaining pages'.

decisions.summary: One note-scoped re-check per question (brief step 7); a PARTIAL left after it is labeled honestly in its note - what the quote carries and does not, or the assertion narrowed to the quote - and not re-checked again
decisions.why: R4 recommendation 2 as written ('One note-scoped re-check per question; a PARTIAL left after it is labeled honestly in the note rather than re-checked again'); narrowing the assertion to the quote is one honest form of that label, not a relaxation of the bound. brief.py step 7 carries it.

decisions.summary: Each of the twelve defined agents' description cut to one sentence, the full statement moved verbatim into the contract under 'When to dispatch this agent'; built-in agent types' descriptions left alone
decisions.why: R4 recommendation 3 names 'the long description fields of the defined agents. One sentence each, with the detail left in the contract body'. Verified on e2777cbf: all 12 old descriptions appear verbatim in the new files; totals reproduce as 8,448 -> 2,122 characters. Built-ins are not defined agents and not ours to edit, so excluding them narrows nothing asked.

decisions.summary: _clone_local_settings.py, run by the clone-sync prompt hook, merges claudeMdExcludes for the mirror's root CLAUDE.md into each clone's untracked .claude/settings.local.json, keeping other keys; mirror untouched
decisions.why: R4 recommendation 4 ('A claudeMdExcludes for the mirror's copy in each clone's untracked .claude/settings.local.json, written when the clone is made or synced'); the prompt hook is the sync point, and it reaches every clone session, the GM's included.

decisions.summary: The equivalent page is religion-and-death (four FR-002, one FR-006), worked exactly as cities/defenses (a write session then two-question check sessions), recorded as R5 with the table over all five rounds (T45, T46)
decisions.why: The GM asked for 'another round of equivalent work to the others so that we can do an apples to apples comparison'; the same session shape, the same meter and a per-item table serve that. The GM named no page.

decisions.summary: T19 excludes religion-and-death as well and is cut when T46's figures are read instead of T41's
decisions.why: Drops nothing: the only page removed is the one T45 now carries, and the cut point moves to the comparison the GM asked to see before the remaining pages.
